seed_source: python secrets.randbits(63), generated once on 2026-10-22 and committed with this file before the feasibility results existed and before any draw was executed on the real pool
partition_rules: Lineages are atomic: every model variant, size, repetition, and training/inference use of a lineage goes to one partition.
Drawn lineages form the test partition; their three training-capable lineages are the attacked test lineages. Eligible lineages not drawn join development/calibration.
Every partition contains ordinary training, inference and non-ML work (test: guaranteed by test_counts; calibration: by the seen lineages).
A candidate is eligible only if its pre-draw feasibility check (feasibility.py) succeeds on amodo; failures are excluded with the recorded error, before the draw.
redraw_rule: Only an attempt that violates a constraint above is redrawn; every attempt and its violations are logged in draw_result.json. Constraints are never relaxed after a draw; if no valid draw exists the draw stops and the problem is reported.
